newsitem.title: USA: CME says IOM seat sale price tops 1996 levels.
newsitem.headline: CME says IOM seat sale price tops 1996 levels.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) said Thursday an Index and Options Market (IOM) seat sold for $280,000 Wednesday, surpassing the highest price paid in 1996.
The exchange said the highest price paid for an IOM seat last year was $274,500 on December 24. Two seats were sold on Monday for $275,000.
"As the new year kicks off, this strong demand for Merc IOM memberships parallels solid 1996 volume in our equity indexes and options on futures," CME Chairman Jack Sandner said in a statement.
IOM seats give the holder the right to trade CME index futures, all CME options and random-length lumber.
